author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a dog's head in profile facing left, with a pointed ear, domed skull, neck, eye dot and an elliptical flying disc held between the open jaws; reads as a dog catching a frisbee. The ear is pointed as in the reference, so it can also read as a fox or cat head. The rejected drawing was an ellipse with zigzag lines. A first attempt that traced the reference's open hook outline (attempts/v1-*) did not read as a head and failed the build gate's internal spacing.
omissions: The reference's slightly tilted disc is axis-aligned; the head gains an eye and a neck back line so it reads as an animal at 48 px.
lucide_reference: No Lucide dog-with-disc; Lucide 'dog' profile ideas (pointed ear, straight muzzle) and ellipse construction.
